name: Neutrl USD
oneLiner: Neutrl's synthetic dollar: minting and redemptions paused 2026-08-13 for reserve-liquidity review; early-redemption process pending review 2026-08-29.
collateral: Accountable currently shows reserves concentrated in liquid stablecoins, with smaller OTC aggregate and other hedged reserve assets; Neutrl describes NUSD as a fully collateralized synthetic dollar backed by delta-neutral strategies and other crypto assets
pegMechanism: As of 2026-08-13, state that NUSD minting, redemptions, and other protocol functions were paused for a reserve-liquidity review. As of 2026-08-29, the proposed early-redemption path was still pending a new contract, audit, and legal/financial review. Retain the permissionless-mint/KYC-redemption description only as the pre-pause design.
